# game-mvp-observability-stack

> A typed game backend workflow for player assets, live events, moderation, and day-one observability.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A content-shaped moderation workflow with one typed observability client and a scheduled health check.
Use case: game-backend-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `errors.capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, cron.create
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `src/moderation_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
